symptoms.lbl: Headache or visual disturbance in pregnancy
Foreign body in ear, nose or throat
Fingers turning white or blue in cold

questions.text: Did it start suddenly (within minutes to hours)?
questions.why: Sudden onset often points to vascular, traumatic or acute inflammatory causes.
Progression helps separate self-limiting from serious disease.

questions.text: Has the patient had similar episodes before?
questions.why: Recurrence suggests a chronic or relapsing cause.

questions.text: Has any treatment been taken, and did it help?
questions.why: Response to treatment and prior drugs affect interpretation.

questions.text: Does it wake the patient from sleep?
questions.why: Night symptoms can signal more serious pathology.

questions.text: Are family members or neighbours similarly ill?
questions.why: Suggests infection, food/water or environmental source.

questions.text: Any recent travel, especially to an endemic area?

questions.why: Drug side effects can cause many symptoms.

questions.text: Did it follow an injury or fall?
